title: Analog Devices (Maxim Integrated) MAX17048/MAX17049 datasheet 19-6171 Rev 7 (11/16), 19 pages
note: analog.com does not answer this machine (HTTP/2 INTERNAL_ERROR; the web fetcher timed out). The bytes were read from the Internet Archive capture of this URL (https://web.archive.org/web/20260924161950/https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/max17048-max17049.pdf, captured 2026-09-24). They are identical (same sha256) to the SparkFun and LCSC copies below. The ADI product page names Rev. 7 as the most up-to-date revision.
supports: p.1 features: 1 cell (MAX17048), +-7.5 mV/cell, 3 uA hibernate / 23 uA active, VRESET 2.28-3.48 V, alerts (low SOC, 1 % change, under/overvoltage, VRESET), I2C, 8-bit OTP ID; 0.9 x 1.7 mm WLP or 2 x 2 mm 8-pin TDFN

p.2 absolute maximum: CELL to GND -0.3 to +12 V; all other pins -0.3 to +6 V; SDA, ALRT continuous sink 20 mA; operating -40 to +85 C; storage -55 to +125 C; lead temperature (TDFN) +300 C 10 s; reflow +260 C

p.2 electrical characteristics (VDD 2.5-4.5 V, TA -20 to +70 C): VDD 2.5/4.5 V; VRST 2.28-3.48 V in 40 mV steps, trimmed 2.85/3.0/3.15 V; data I/O pins (SCL, SDA, ALRT) -0.3 to +5.5 V; IDD0 sleep 0.5/2 uA (TA <= 50 C), hibernate 3/5 uA (comparator disabled), 4 uA (enabled); IDD1 active 23/40 uA; time base +-1/+-3.5 %; ADC period 250 ms active, 45 s hibernate; VERR +-7.5 mV/cell at 3.6 V 25 C, +-20 mV/cell over range; resolution 1.25 mV/cell; measurement range 2.5-5 V on VDD (MAX17048); VIH 1.4 V, VIL 0.5 V (SDA, SCL, QSTRT); VOL 0.4 V at 4 mA (SDA, ALRT); IPD 0.2/0.4 uA; tSLEEP 1.75-2.5 s
p.3 I2C electrical characteristics: fSCL 0-400 kHz, bus capacitance 400 pF, input capacitance 60 pF; Note 6 shutdown after SCL and SDA < VIL for longer than 2.5 s

p.6 pin configuration (TDFN top view, pad side down: 1 CTG, 2 CELL, 3 VDD, 4 GND along one edge; 8 SDA, 7 SCL, 6 QSTRT, 5 ALRT along the other) and pin descriptions including EP (TDFN only, connect to GND)
p.8 battery insertion debounce: OCV ready 17 ms after insertion, SOC 175 ms after that
p.9-10 quick-start, POR, hibernate (below 5 uA), alert interrupt (ALRT driven low until CONFIG.ALRT cleared), sleep mode (MODE.EnSleep = 1 and bus low for tSLEEP, or CONFIG.SLEEP = 1)
p.10-14 register summary (VCELL 78.125 uV/cell, SOC 1/256 %, CRATE 0.208 %/hr, CONFIG default 0x971C, ATHD default 4 %), VRESET guidance (2.5 V for captive batteries), CMD 0x5400 reset
p.15 Figure 14 MAX17048 application circuit (VDD and CELL to the cell, 0.1 uF, CTG and QSTRT to GND) and Table 3 configurations; system must provide pull-ups for ALRT, SDA, SCL
p.16 I2C bus system: slave-only, 7-bit address 0b0110110 fixed (0x6C write / 0x6D read)

p.18 ordering information (MAX17048G+T10: -40 to +85 C, 8 TDFN-EP, + = lead-free/RoHS, T = tape and reel) and package information (8 TDFN-EP, package code T822+3, outline 21-0168, land pattern 90-0065)
p.19 revision history (Rev 7, 11/16)
